notes.title: Wendy's Mart Early Access. New Update, Coming Soon!
Thank you for Joining to Wendy's Mart 3D Early Access
notes.notes:
Thank you for joining to Wendy's Mart 3D and thank you for your support.

For new users: Wendy's Mart 3D is an EARLY ACCESS and PRE-ALPHA, it's in active development, currently there will bugs, optimization issues, missing objects and incomplete features. It's NOT RECOMMENDED to purchase if you want to play a fully-features of the game, currently the duration of the game is short.

Wendy's Mart 3D Early Access is to know the idea of the game and explore it.
You can join and we appreciate your support!

Wendy's Mart 3D will have important updates every 2 or 3 weeks.
